review_scope: Truck and garage generated static concept sheets; final submitted art iteration for this review

defect_disposition.summary: Original large rounded truck identity used.
Rear cab is solid bulkhead with small rear window.
Open garage truck and horizontal blades fully behind front doorway.

residual_notes.summary: Generated views are not dimensionally exact geometry; incidental small fittings and cargo details vary. They need a single explicit modeling geometry and real multi-angle model review before production.

unverified_mandatory_production_evidence: Measured whole-vehicle and blade collision clearance
Actual door/fence replacement and two camp exits
Driving controls, steering, suspension, stopping and reverse
Blade full cycles, contact/miss/interruption across enemy/tree/mineral targets
Docking/unloading animation and cargo accounting integration
Independent actual-scene final review and owner design approval
score_interpretation: No score here certifies implemented gameplay or final reference fidelity. The existing per-dimension9.9/exact10 production gates remain open. No average hides missing runtime evidence.
